risks: Treating platform ChannelBinding/sessionId or send_agent_message as human Channel/Message would silently mix agent transcript and human collaboration.
Registering domain handlers behind messagingRegistry early return would make human messaging depend on external platform gateway availability.
RequestContext client/workspace IDs and local org roster are not authenticated principal authority; body author IDs must never become trusted shared actor.
Global rox-team-state-v1 cache can cross workspace/principal boundaries; memory fallback is not durable acceptance and revoke must stop protected projection display.

Missing detailed edit/delete/create/timeline contracts and ambiguous parent-versus-discussion/root aggregate revision policy must be resolved before code; guessed DTOs would create incompatible public API.
WP-08 full mentions gate depends on downstream WP-09; adding a reverse DAG edge creates a cycle. Stage substrate implementation and leave complete status pending until assembled integrations.
Company same-API criterion needs a real canonical Company and existing renderer binding; mock/fixture Company is preparation only, not live user-visible receipt.
Shared search/attention/offline/agent prerequisites are not listed as WP-08 explicit edges; silently omitting them or marking N/A would weaken published featureCompleteness.
Legacy comment imports must retain ID aliases and parent/workspace provenance; display-name/email-based merges or arbitrary parent inference must quarantine rather than expose data.
Workspace-wide raw-body push can leak private discussion; current generic PushTarget does not itself enforce resource ACL or revoke fence.
Claimed outbox lease is not processed; consumer unique event ID plus revision/tombstone/policy fences must prevent duplicate notifications and resurrection of deleted text.
Tool schema converter removes additionalProperties; strict trusted server validation is mandatory for actor rejection regardless of advertised tool JSON schema.
Proposed SQL filename is not a verified applied migration; do not invent timestamp or duplicate receipt/alias/outbox foundation tables.
All source evidence is snapshot-based and can go stale during root integration. No tests, build, native UI/network operation or runtime verification occurred in this preflight.
